name: slop-check
description: A scanner for writing that reads as AI-written, and the discipline for using it without sanding good prose flat.

plugins.name: slop-check
plugins.description: Flags AI writing tells in outward-facing prose before it is sent or published. Warns, never blocks. Covers Wikipedia's signs-of-AI-writing patterns, British spellings in American copy, B2B outreach cliches, and the phrases Claude reaches for constantly.
